				}
				add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_CHL_choice_early_exit_2 days = 180 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CHL_early_exit_cooldown value = 1 days = 180 }
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_early_exit_event_seen
			}
		}
	}

	desc = COLDWAR_CHL_event_truth_desc
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		hidden_trigger = { COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes }
	}
	immediate = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_truth_event_seen }
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_CHL_event_truth_option_1
		effect_tooltip = {
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.47638 }
			divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 100 }
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_gdp_setup_chl_0p15_tt
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_choice_truth_1
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_repression
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_limited_accountability
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_lasting_legacy
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_reparations_full
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_truth_full
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 8.25729 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 52 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 100000 }
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_gdp_annual_chl_0p00005_tt
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_weekly_quote_billions = COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_weekly_expense_tt }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_truth_choice_resolved
		}

			if = {
				limit = {
					COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes

					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_truth_choice_resolved }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.47638 }
				divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 100 }
				custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_gdp_setup_chl_0p15_tt
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_choice_truth_1
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_repression
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_limited_accountability
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_lasting_legacy
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_reparations_full
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_truth_full
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_truth_choice_resolved
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
